var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

var category = function () {

bookSourceComment: //不登录只能看免费章节

QQ资源群：992706162

TG交流群：https://t.me/huanmengnovel

由于一直疯狂被人举报免费书源、软件、QQ群，所以QQ群以后长期禁言

幻梦轻小说全网最齐全的轻小说网，访问速度优质而且网页内置插图，拥有海量的轻小说书籍，如果有网页bug或者需求的小说可以进网站群及时反馈


作者留言：

1.0更新：本网站所有的小说都是免费的，目前已经有了PC端和wap端，APP端目前还有点问题需要调试

本次初次制作好了对接阅读的书源，但是为了避免被大规模盗刷流量，书源暂时没有对接插图

2.0更新：本次更新解决了插图问题，让书源可以显示插图，显示不出来多刷新就行

站长在Cdn处新增速率限制，超过限制会被拉黑，国外地区也会无法访问插图，非官网访问也会无法访问插图

如果后续阅读方面流量过于异常，我会关闭阅读的阅读插图渠道，希望各位可以理解

2.1更新：新增发现页面的选项功能，用户可以更快速便捷的从分类和题材中寻找自己想要的小说

2.2更新：修复发现页面的分类功能异常的问题，现在移除文库分类

2.3更新：修复发现界面过于拥挤，点击作者无法快速搜索作者，总有几本推荐阅读始终占据分类书籍顶部的问题，这里感谢QQ用户雪隐梅香提供的修复


2.4更新：优化了插图排版的问题，如果插图不是一张图片一页，可以尝试在阅读界面右上角手动把图片样式改为SINGLE

2.5更新：本次网站将图床更换为了下行宽带300M，上行200M的大宽带服务器，方便大家更快的使用。与此同时修复了更换图床后，插图异常不显示的问题

2.6更新：网友修改优化版本，由于海外线路需要人机交互，修复了海外线路被阻拦，无法使用书源的问题

2.7更新：修复阅读app下载过快，会触发拉黑的问题，限制并发

2.8更新：兼容苹果用户的读不舍手书源，修复目录异常的问题

注意：

此书源支持苹果用户的TF测试版的读不舍手

以前书源版本可能会出现目录没有文章，或者显示异常

我没有苹果手机，也无法测试和写书源，能够适配一个苹果书源我已经尽力了，大家见谅


2.9更新：上调并发率，并发率太低可能会出现图片加载异常，太高会导致被拉黑

3.0更新：在发现功能中，新增一个【最新】按钮功能，自动索引获取时间戳最新入库50本小说

更多详情内容，可以关注：www.huanmengacg.com

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
flag=source.getVariable()=="1"?true:false

var json=java.getElement("@css:.volume-wrap h3,.volume-wrap li");
list=[];
for(i in json){
	vol=json[i].select("a").attr("class");
	if(vol.indexOf("subscri")!=-1){
		volname=json[i].text();
		list.push({
			text:"★"+String(volname).replace(/.共\d+章.*|.订阅本卷/g,'')+"★",
			voltype:true
			})
		}else{
a=json[i].select("a")
			vip=json[i].select("em.iconfont").text()!=""?"🔒":""
			
			text=a.text();
			href=a.attr("href");
			time=a.attr("alt");
			href=flag?href+",{'webView': true}":href
			
			list.push({
			text:String(vip+text).replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*?[求更谢乐发订合补加].*?[】）\)].*/g,''),

exploreUrl:
<js>
let res = [];
let _zwf = "※";
let numx = 3;

function push(title, url, num, g,action) {
    let j = {
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
        layout_flexGrow: g == 0 ? g : 1,
        layout_flexBasisPercent: num
    }
  }
     if(action){
         j.action = action.action;
         j.name = action.name;
         j.type = action.type;
         j.chars = action.chars;
         j.viewName = action.viewName;
         j.default = action.default;      
     }     
     res.push(j)	
}

function zwf(len,numx,num) {
  if(len % numx !== 0) {
    let n = len % numx;
    let p = numx - n;
      
    for(let i=0;i<p;i++) {
      push(_zwf, '', num, 1,{
      "type":"button",
      "action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
    }
  }
}

// 大类
let defaultV = "漫画";
push("模式", "", 1, 1, {
  "type": "select",
  "chars": ["漫画", "里番"],
  "action": `switchMode(${'infoMap["模式"]'})`,
  "default": defaultV
});

if (infoMap["模式"] == "漫画") {
  var labels = getLabels(infoMap["模式"]);
  labels = JSON.parse(labels);
 
  // 子类1
  // 一级子类
  let groups = labels['groups'].map(x => x.type);
  push('分组', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": groups,
    "action": `switchGroup("${infoMap['分组']}")`,
    "default": groups[0]
  });

  // 二级子类
  let _labels = {};
  let __labels = {};
  labels['groups'].forEach(x => {
    _labels[x.type] = x.labels.map(x=>x.cn+'('+x.count+')');
    x.labels.forEach(item => {
      const key = `${item.cn}(${item.count})`;
      __labels[key] = item.name;
    });
  });

  defaultV = _labels[groups[0]][0];
  push('标签', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": _labels[infoMap['分组']],
    "action": `switchLabel("${infoMap['标签']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 子类2
  let chars2 = ["最新", "评分", "收藏", "浏览", "最早"];
  let _chars2 = {
    "最新": "latest",
    "评分": "rating",
    "收藏": "favorites",
    "浏览": "view_count",
    "最早": "oldest"
  };
  defaultV = chars2[0];
  push('排序', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": chars2,
    "action": `switchLabel2("${infoMap['排序']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 子类3
  let chars3 = ['全部', '最近7天', '最近30天'];
  let _chars3 = {'全部': 'all', '最近7天': '7d', '最近30天': '30d'};
  defaultV = chars3[0]
  push('时间', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": chars3,
    "action": `switchLabel3("${infoMap['时间']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 是否显示 bl
  push('bl  (点我切换)', '', 1, 1, {
    "type": "toggle",
    "chars": ["不显示", "显示"],
    "action": `isShowBl('');`,
    "default": "不显示"
  });
  
  let url = `https://macapi1.com/ehentai/galleries?page={{page}}&page_size=20&label=${__labels[infoMap['标签']]}&sort=${_chars2[infoMap['排序']]}&time_range=${_chars3[infoMap['时间']]}&show_bl=${infoMap['bl  (点我切换)'] == "不显示"?0:1}`;
  push('go，go，go！出发喽！', url, 1, 1, { });

} else if (infoMap["模式"] == "里番") {
  var labels = getLabels(infoMap["模式"]);
  labels = JSON.parse(labels);
  labels = labels['data'];
  // 子类
  let url = 'https://macapi1.com/anilist/works?page={{page}}&page_size=20&genre={genre}&sort=latest';
  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i ++) {
    push(
      labels[i].genre_zh+'('+labels[i].count+')', 
      url.replace(/{genre}/, labels[i].genre), 
      0.33, 1, {});
  }
 zwf(labels.length, 2, 0.33);
}

JSON.stringify(res);
</js>

const matches = result.match(/\n\s*url:\s*'(.*?)'/);
let url = matches 
  ? matches[1] 
  : "https://www.deqixs.co/modules/article/ajax2.php";
const SECRET_KEY = result.match(/SECRET_KEY:\s*'([^']+)',/)?.[1] || "";
const timestamp = Date.now(); 
const nonce = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 8);
const rawStr = baseUrl + '_' + timestamp + '_' + nonce + '_' + SECRET_KEY; 
const token = java.md5Encode(rawStr);
const [, aid, cid] = baseUrl.match(/\/books\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html/);
const params = {aid, cid, token, timestamp, nonce};
const paramStr =	Object.entries(params)
    .map(x=>x.join("=")).join("&");
const headers = {
	  "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12; NOP-AN00 Build/HUAWEINOP-AN01P) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/114.0.5735.196 Mobile Safari/537.36",
	 "Referer": baseUrl,
	 "Accept":	"text/plain, */*; q=0.01",
  "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
}
url += "?"+paramStr+","+JSON.stringify({
	 headers
})

java.ajax(url)
</js>

            "id": o.id,
            "title": o.cN,
            "v": o.sS == 0,

        var content_url = {

        chart.url = `data:;base64,${content_url},{"type":"qtqd"}`;
        charts.push(chart);
    })
})
charts;
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let list = [];
let push = (text, href, vol) => list.push({
    "text": text,
    "href": href,
    "vol": vol
});
let v = java.getElements('#chapterList>li');
for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
    if (v[i].attr('class') != 'w33p') {
        push(v[i].text(), v[i].attr('href'), true)
    } else {
        t = v[i].select('a')
        push(t.text(), t.attr('href'), false)
    }
}
list;
</js>

let url = `https://www.deqixs.co/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&referrer=${baseUrl}`;

eval(String(tokenHtml));

let params = {
  aid,
  cid,
  token: chapterToken,
  timestamp,
  nonce
};
let paramStr =	Object.entries(params)
    .map(x=>x.join("=")).join("&");
let headers = {
	 "Referer": baseUrl,
	 "Accept":	"text/plain, */*; q=0.01",
  "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
}
url = "https://www.deqixs.co/modules/article/ajax2.php?"+paramStr+","+JSON.stringify({
	 headers
})

java.ajax(url)
</js>

<js>
if(result.match(/百度安全验证/)){
	xb=(baseUrl)+","+JSON.stringify({
		"headers":{
			"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86 64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/127.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}})
java.startBrowserAwait(xb,"验证")
result=java.ajax(xb)
	}

var bookList = [];
var finalJsonOutput = null;
try {
    var doc = result;
    if (!doc) {
        throw new Error("无法解析 HTML");
    }
    var containers = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(doc).select("div.c-container.result-op, div.c-container.result");
    java.log("找到 " + containers.size() + " 个");
    for (var i = 0; i < containers.size(); i++) {
        var container = containers.get(i);
        var book = {};
        if (container.hasClass("result-op")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " 个 (result-op)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;             
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                    //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var authorElement = container.selectFirst("span");
            if (authorElement) {
                var authorText = authorElement.text().trim();
                var prefix = "作者： "; 
                if (authorText.includes(prefix)) {
                    book.author = authorText.substring(prefix.length).trim();
                } else {
                    book.author = "未找到";
                    //java.log("作者信息未找到或格式不符: " + authorElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.author = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到作者对应的 span 标签");
            }            
            var introElement = container.selectFirst("div.text_2NOr6");
            var introText = null;
            if (introElement) {
                introText = introElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = introText;                 
                book.kind = null; 
                if (!introText.startsWith("简介:")) {
                    var kindPrefix = "类别:";
                    var kindIndex = introText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                    if (kindIndex !== -1) {
                        var kindTemp = introText.substring(kindIndex + kindPrefix.length).trim();
                        var chapterPrefix = "最新章节"; 
                        var chapterIndex = kindTemp.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                        if (chapterIndex !== -1) {
                            book.kind = kindTemp.substring(0, chapterIndex).trim(); 
                        } else {
                            book.kind = kindTemp; 
                        }
                    } else {
                        //java.log("未在 intro 文本中找到 '类别:' 用于提取 kind: " + introText);
                    }
                } else {
                    //java.log("intro 文本以 '简介:' 开头，kind 设为 null");
                }
            } else {
                book.intro = null; 
                book.kind = null;
                //java.log("未找到 intro/kind 对应的 div.text_2NOr6 标签");
            }            
            var allAElements = container.select("a");
            if (allAElements.size() >= 2) {
                book.lastChapter = allAElements.get(allAElements.size() - 2).text().trim();
            } else {
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                //java.log("a 标签数量不足，无法提取倒数第二个作为 lastChapter");
            }
        } else if (container.hasClass("result")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " (result)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;            
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                   //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var contentRightElement = container.selectFirst(".content-right_1THTn");
            if (contentRightElement) {
                var fullText = contentRightElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = fullText;                 
                book.author = null; 
                var authorPrefix = "作者:"; 
                var authorIndex = fullText.indexOf(authorPrefix);
                var kindSeparator = "类别"; 
                var kindIndexForAuthor = fullText.indexOf(kindSeparator);
                if (authorIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = authorIndex + authorPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (kindIndexForAuthor !== -1 && kindIndexForAuthor > authorIndex) ? kindIndexForAuthor : fullText.length;
                    book.author = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '作者:'");
                }                
                book.kind = null; 
                var kindPrefix = "类别:"; 
                var kindIndex = fullText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                var chapterSeparator = "最新章节"; 
                var chapterIndexForKind = fullText.indexOf(chapterSeparator);
                if (kindIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = kindIndex + kindPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (chapterIndexForKind !== -1 && chapterIndexForKind > kindIndex) ? chapterIndexForKind : fullText.length;
                    book.kind = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '类别:'");
                }                
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                var chapterPrefix = "最新章节:"; 
                var chapterIndex = fullText.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                var updateSeparator = "最新更新"; 
                var updateIndex = fullText.indexOf(updateSeparator);

                if (chapterIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = chapterIndex + chapterPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (updateIndex !== -1 && updateIndex > chapterIndex) ? updateIndex : fullText.length;
                    book.lastChapter = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '最新章节:'");
                }
            } else {                
                book.author = null;
                book.kind = null;
                book.lastChapter = null;
                book.intro = null;
                //java.log("未找到 .content-right_1THTn 元素");
            }
        } else {
            //java.log("跳过未知类型的容器: " + container.outerHtml().substring(0, 100));
            continue; 
        }        
        bookList.push(book);
    }
    var finalResult = {
        bookList: bookList 
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(finalResult);
} catch (e) {
    java.log("错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify({
        bookList: []
    }); 
}
result = finalJsonOutput;
</js>

        }
    });
};
var addSlots = (count, style) => {
    var remainder = count % 3;
    var slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (var i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("书架", null, 1);

    	   showR18 = true;
    	   push("阅读历史", "/api/user/read-history?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30", 0.25);
        var favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
        favoredData.forEach(item => {

}
push("来源", null, 1);

});

});

if (['6', '7', '8', '9'].includes(get)) {
    var cnContent = data[config[1]] || data[config[2]] || data[config[3]] || data[config[4]];
    var jpContent = data[config[5]];
    if (cnContent) {
        if (['8', '9'].includes(get)) {
            var res = java.post(
                'https://static.kksk.io/api/kanji',
                JSON.stringify({"content": format(regex(jpContent))}),
                {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            );
            var kanji = JSON.parse(res.body());
            jpContent = jpContent.map(text => annotate(text, kanji));
        }
        var type = ['6', '8'].includes(get);
        content = jpContent.flatMap((jp, i) => {
            if (!((jp || '').trim() && (cnContent[i] || '').trim())) return [];
            var pair = type ? [cnContent[i], jp] : [jp, cnContent[i]];
            return pair.filter(Boolean).concat(i === jpContent.length - 1 ? [] : '\u200B');
        }).filter(Boolean);
    } else {
        content = jpContent;
    }
}
format(regex(content));
</js>

var providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:books\d?\.fishhawk\.top|n\.novelia\.cc)\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
var url;
for (var provider in providers) {
    var match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        var providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        var novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    }
}
if (!url) {
    url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=1`;
}
url;
</js>

<js>
function replace (content) {
  const source = "内暴强情缝贪插逼操潮喷阴艳裸乳荡穴鸡淫苞奸胸射嫩肉骚性蒂茎陰騷奶屄成人药春迷尿粉肛龟头A精屌口狂蜜处女唇道阳虐虫妇液色颜熟交爽臀爆舔做爱欲吹自慰点gG玉幼援抽Bb水母狗户部要了奴小脚痒酥死我兽揉搓捏扣抠棍棒洞密美少摩腿春乱伦露漏浪开巨根菊巴黑豪好肥送艳被干拔乱理白刺体下面诱感快货比日妈你娘婊子配仙火叫在里子宫给聊照流群屁眼马无码友拳洞片黄偷禁套弄位脱光舒服溜舞丢还糜妻换妓招嫖娼aA毛Hh一夜本热推图书娃男抓浑圆饱满润湿滑丰腴韵尤物横陈存娇喘息麻桃透风腹长粗肿胀人紧夹吸撅起来雪发翘硕大胴双草坐挲跨柔软臂瘫媚秘破"
  const replacementChars = source.split("")
  replacementChars[43]="AV"
  content = content.replace(/<i class="icon icon-uni(.{4})"><\/i>/g, (_, p1) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(p1, 16)));

  return Array.from(content, char => {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0)
    if (code >= 0xE001 && code <= 0xE101) {
      return replacementChars[code - 0xE001]
    } else {
      return char
    }
  }).join('')
}
replace(result)
</js>

exploreUrl:
<js>
discover = [];
push = (title, url, style) => discover.push({ title: title, url: url, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: style } });
addSlots = (count, style) => {
    remainder = count % 3;
    slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("收藏夹", null, 1);
try {
    favored = java.ajax(`${baseUrl}/api/user/favored`);
    if (favored.includes("Token")) {
        push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
        addSlots(1, 0.25);
    } else {
        favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
        favoredData.forEach(item => {
            push(item.title, `/api/user/favored-web/${item.id}?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30&sort=update`, 0.25);
        });
        addSlots(favoredData.length, 0.25);
    }
} catch (e) {
    push("未知错误", null, 0.25);
    addSlots(1, 0.25);
};
push("来源", null, 1);
providers = ["全部", "kakuyomu", "syosetu", "novelup", "hameln", "pixiv", "alphapolis"];
providers.forEach(provider => {
    url = provider === "全部" ? 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${providers.slice(1).join('%2C')}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0` : 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${provider}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(provider, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(providers.length, 0.25);
push("类型", null, 1);
types = ["全部", "连载中", "已完结", "短篇"];
types.forEach((type, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=${index}&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(type, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(types.length, 0.25);
push("排序", null, 1);
sorts = ["更新", "点击"];
sorts.forEach((sort, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=${index}`;
    push(sort, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(sorts.length, 0.25);
JSON.stringify(discover);
</js>

loginUrl:
<js>
function login() {
    username = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号");
    password = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码");
    url = `${baseUrl}/api/auth/sign-in`;
    body = JSON.stringify({
        emailOrUsername: username,
        password: password
    });
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    };
    response = java.post(url, body, headers);
    responseBody = response.body();
    authorizationObject = {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${responseBody}`
    };
    header = JSON.stringify(authorizationObject);
    source.putLoginHeader(header);
}
login();
</js>

<js>
providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?books\d?\.fishhawk\.top\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
for (provider in providers) {
    match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    } else {
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=1`;
    }
    url
}
</js>

// 按照发现页的分类进行搜索
// @author: syiism
exploreUrl:
<js>
let res = [];
let _zwf = "※";
let numx = 3;

function push(title, url, num, g,action) {
    let j = {
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
        layout_flexGrow: g == 0 ? g : 1,
        layout_flexBasisPercent: num
    }
  }
     if(action){
         j.action = action.action;
         j.name = action.name;
         j.type = action.type;
         j.chars = action.chars;
         j.viewName = action.viewName;
         j.default = action.default;      
     }     
     res.push(j)	
}

function zwf(len,numx,num) {
  if(len % numx !== 0) {
    let n = len % numx;
    let p = numx - n;
      
    for(let i=0;i<p;i++) {
      push(_zwf, '', num, 1,{
      "type":"button",
      "action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
    }
  }
}

// 大类
let defaultV = "漫画";
push("模式", "", 1, 1, {
  "type": "select",
  "chars": ["漫画", "里番"],
  "action": `switchMode(${'infoMap["模式"]'})`,
  "default": defaultV
});

if (infoMap["模式"] == "漫画") {
  var labels = getLabels(infoMap["模式"]);
  labels = JSON.parse(labels);
 
  // 子类1
  // 一级子类
  let groups = labels['groups'].map(x => x.type);
  push('分组', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": groups,
    "action": `switchGroup("${infoMap['分组']}")`,
    "default": groups[0]
  });

  // 二级子类
  let _labels = {};
  let __labels = {};
  labels['groups'].forEach(x => {
    _labels[x.type] = x.labels.map(x=>x.cn+'('+x.count+')');
    x.labels.forEach(item => {
      const key = `${item.cn}(${item.count})`;
      __labels[key] = item.name;
    });
  });

  defaultV = _labels[groups[0]][0];
  push('标签', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": _labels[infoMap['分组']],
    "action": `switchLabel("${infoMap['标签']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 子类2
  let chars2 = ["最新", "评分", "收藏", "浏览", "最早"];
  let _chars2 = {
    "最新": "latest",
    "评分": "rating",
    "收藏": "favorites",
    "浏览": "view_count",
    "最早": "oldest"
  };
  defaultV = chars2[0];
  push('排序', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": chars2,
    "action": `switchLabel2("${infoMap['排序']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 子类3
  let chars3 = ['全部', '最近7天', '最近30天'];
  let _chars3 = {'全部': 'all', '最近7天': '7d', '最近30天': '30d'};
  defaultV = chars3[0]
  push('时间', '', 0.45, 1, {
    "type": "select",
    "chars": chars3,
    "action": `switchLabel3("${infoMap['时间']}")`,
    "default": defaultV
  });

  // 是否显示 bl
  push('bl  (点我切换)', '', 1, 1, {
    "type": "toggle",
    "chars": ["不显示", "显示"],
    "action": `isShowBl('');`,
    "default": "不显示"
  });
  
  let url = `https://macapi1.com/ehentai/galleries?page={{page}}&page_size=20&label=${__labels[infoMap['标签']]}&sort=${_chars2[infoMap['排序']]}&time_range=${_chars3[infoMap['时间']]}&show_bl=${infoMap['bl  (点我切换)'] == "不显示"?0:1}`;
  push('go，go，go！出发喽！', url, 1, 1, { });

} else if (infoMap["模式"] == "里番") {
  var labels = getLabels(infoMap["模式"]);
  labels = JSON.parse(labels);
  labels = labels['data'];
  // 子类
  let url = 'https://macapi1.com/anilist/works?page={{page}}&page_size=20&genre={genre}&sort=latest';
  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i ++) {
    push(
      labels[i].genre_zh+'('+labels[i].count+')', 
      url.replace(/{genre}/, labels[i].genre), 
      0.33, 1, {});
  }
 zwf(labels.length, 2, 0.33);
}

JSON.stringify(res);
</js>

var preElements = document.select('div#content-section.content-section > pre');

    result = '未找到 div#content-section.content-section > pre 元素';
} else {
    var preElement = preElements.first();
    var innerHtml = preElement.html();
    
    // 定义转换函数（注意：在 Rhino 中使用 var 或 function）
    function convertHtmlToPlainTextWithLineBreaks(html) {
        var text = html;
        text = text.replaceAll(" ", " ");
        text = text.replaceAll("(?i)<p[^>]*><\\/p>", "\n");
        text = text.replaceAll("(?i)<p[^>]*>(.*?)<\\/p>", "\n$1\n");
        text = text.replaceAll("(?i)<br\\s*\\/?>", "\n");
        text = text.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", "");
        text = text.replaceAll("\\n{3,}", "\n\n");
        return text.trim();
    }
    
    // 调用函数，获取纯文本
    var plainText = convertHtmlToPlainTextWithLineBreaks(innerHtml);
    result = plainText;
}
</js>

(function(){
    var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result, baseUrl);
    function trim(s){ return s ? String(s).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "") : ""; }
    function text(el){ return el ? trim(el.text()) : ""; }
    function absHref(el){ return el ? trim(el.attr("abs:href")) : ""; }
    function norm(s){ return trim(String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ")); }
    function forumIdFromUrl(u){ var m = String(u || "").match(/[?&]fid=(\d+)/); return m ? m[1] : ""; }
    function forumNameFromId(fid){ if (fid == "30") return "中文百合漫画区"; if (fid == "49") return "文学区"; if (fid == "55") return "轻小说/译文区"; return ""; }
    function cleanForumName(s){ return norm(s).replace(/^#/, "").replace(/文學區/g, "文学区"); }
    function makeBookUrl(threadUrl, uid){ var m = String(threadUrl || "").match(/[?&]tid=(\d+)/); if (m && uid) return "https://bbs.yamibo.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=" + m[1] + "&page=1&authorid=" + uid + "&mobile=2"; return trim(threadUrl || ""); }
    function shouldKeep(title, desc, forumId, label, icon){
        if (!title) return false;
        if (icon && icon.indexOf("投票") >= 0) return false;
        if (!/^(30|49|55)$/.test(String(forumId || ""))) return false;
        if (/版规|版規|目录编辑教程|目錄編輯教程|新人须知|新人須知|如何找回账号|如何修改密码|禁止转载|禁止轉載|求助|報到|签到|簽到|公告/.test(title)) return false;
        var hay = [title, desc, label].join(" ");
        var kw = /(翻译|翻譯|渣翻|自翻|渣译|渣譯|转载|轉載|生肉|更新|话|話|章|长篇|長篇|短篇|中篇|译介|譯介|文库|文庫|完结|完結|汉化组|漢化組|汉化|漢化|第.{0,10}[话話章]|[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百零〇]+[话話章])/i;
        return kw.test(hay);
    }
    var list = [];
    var items = doc.select('.threadlist li.list');
    for (var i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
        var li = items.get(i);
        var title = norm(text(li.select('.threadlist_tit').first()));
        var poster = text(li.select('.muser a.mmc').first());
        var uidHref = absHref(li.select('.muser a.mmc').first());
        var uidM = uidHref.match(/[?&]uid=(\d+)/);
        var uid = uidM ? uidM[1] : '';
        var desc = norm(text(li.select('.threadlist_mes').first()));
        var labelEl = li.select('.threadlist_foot li.mr a').first();
        var label = cleanForumName(text(labelEl));
        var forumHref = absHref(labelEl);
        var forumId = forumIdFromUrl(forumHref) || forumIdFromUrl(baseUrl);
        var forumName = forumNameFromId(forumId) || label;
        var icon = norm(text(li.select('.threadlist_tit .micon, .threadlist_tit em').first())).replace(/[\[\]]/g, '');
        if (!shouldKeep(title, desc, forumId, label, icon)) continue;
        var threadUrl = absHref(li.select("a[href*='viewthread']").first());
        var bookUrl = makeBookUrl(threadUrl, uid);
        var kind = '百合会' + (forumName ? ',' + forumName : '') + (icon ? ',' + icon : '');
        var intro = (forumName ? ('[' + forumName + '] ') : '') + desc;
        list.push({name:title, author: trim(poster || ''), kind:kind, word:'', last:text(li.select('.mtime').first()), intro:intro, cover:'', url:bookUrl});
    }
    return list;
})();
</js>

        t = t.replace(/\s+\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\s*(?:\(\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\))?\s*$/g, '');
        return trim(t);
    }
    function firstMeaningful(lines, rawTitle, imgCount){
        if (imgCount >= 2) return rawTitle;
        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length && i < 16; i++) {
            var line = lines[i];
            if (/^(作品名稱|作品名称|作品名|書名|书名|標題|标题|題名|题名|原名|作者\s*[:：]?|原作\s*[:：]?|原著\s*[:：]?|翻譯\s*[:：]?|翻译\s*[:：]?|譯者\s*[:：]?|译者\s*[:：]?|校對\s*[:：]?|校对\s*[:：]?|圖源\s*[:：]?|图源\s*[:：]?|嵌字\s*[:：]?|漢化\s*[:：]?|汉化\s*[:：]?|簡介\s*[:：]?|简介\s*[:：]?|內容簡介\s*[:：]?|内容简介\s*[:：]?|原文简介\s*[:：]?|作品連結\s*[:：]?|作品链接\s*[:：]?|連結\s*[:：]?|链接\s*[:：]?|原地址\s*[:：]?|生肉\s*[:：]?|作品標籤\s*[:：]?|作品标签\s*[:：]?|主題\s*[:：]?|主题\s*[:：]?|目錄|目录|邊看邊翻|边看边翻|嚴禁劇透|严禁剧透)/.test(line)) continue;
            if (/^[0-9]{1,3}(后)?$/.test(line)) continue;
            if (line.length <= 1) continue;
            return line;
        }
        return rawTitle;
    }
    function isIntroCatalogPost(index, lines, msg){
        if (index != 0) return false;
        var tocLinks = msg.select("a[href*='goto=findpost'], a[href*='pid=']").size();
        if (tocLinks >= 2) return true;
        var joined = lines.join('\n');
        if (/(作品名稱|作品名称|作品名|書名|书名|作者|原作|原著|簡介|简介)/.test(joined) && /(目錄|目录|索引)/.test(joined)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function isChapter(name, text, imgCount){
        if (imgCount >= 2) return true;
        if (/^(前言|序章|后记|後記|番外|楔子|序|终章|終章|尾声|尾聲|最終話|最终话|第.{0,16}[话話章节章卷篇回]|[一二三四五六七八九十百零〇0-9]+[话話章节章卷篇回])/.test(name)) return true;
        if (text.length >= 180) return true;
        return false;
    }

    var list = [];
    var posts = doc.select('.plc.cl');
    var pageUrl = String(baseUrl || '').replace(/([?&])__pid=\d+/g, '$1').replace(/&&+/g, '&').replace(/#pid\d+$/g, '');
    var rawTitle = cleanThreadTitle();
    for (var i = 0; i < posts.size(); i++) {
        var post = posts.get(i);
        var pid = String(post.id() || '').replace(/^pid/, '');
        var msg = post.select('.message').first();
        if (!pid || !msg) continue;
        var lines = linesFromMessage(msg);
        if (isIntroCatalogPost(i, lines, msg)) continue;
        var text = lines.join('\n');
        var imgCount = msg.select('img').size();
        var name = firstMeaningful(lines, rawTitle, imgCount);
        if (!isChapter(name, text, imgCount)) continue;
        var url = pageUrl + (pageUrl.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + '__pid=' + pid + '#pid' + pid;
        list.push({name: name || rawTitle, url: url});
    }
    return list;
})();
